title: Bitcoin breaks below $60K as AI stocks crash; $1.5B liquidated | Weekend Brief
caption:
bitcoin broke below $60k for the first time since july, now near $59k 📉 eth -8% to ~$1,620, sol ~$69. ~$1.5b liquidated in a day, over 90% longs. btc etfs -$582m thursday, with blackrock's ibit posting a record -$541m. the driver: an ai stock rout, the nasdaq fell 5%+ and erased its 2026 gains. next week: pce + gdp wed, us markets closed thu. levels to watch: $60k and $58k. how are you trading the weekend? not financial advice.
